name: broom
description: Autonomous code hygiene: sets up the formatters, linters, type checkers and language servers a repo needs, then formats, lints and type-checks what Claude commits and blocks the commit until it's clean. Language servers for Go, TS/JS, Rust and Python.

format_on.title: Format
format_on.description: When broom runs formatters: on git commit, after every edit as well as on commit, or never

format_scope.title: Format scope
format_scope.description: How much of a file broom reformats: only the lines that changed (like an IDE's 'only VCS changed text'), the functions holding them (found by the language server), or the whole file

check_on.title: Lint and type-check
check_on.description: When broom blocks on lint and type errors: on git commit, when Claude stops as well as on commit, or never
